result.summary: The environment is an industrial area characterized by a very wide, undivided roadway with significant heavy truck traffic. While a high-visibility continental crosswalk is present, the lack of traffic control signals and the extreme crossing distance create a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway is extremely wide without any median or refuge, leaving pedestrians exposed to traffic for a long duration.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, spanning the width of the road

hazards.name: Heavy Vehicle Traffic
hazards.description: Multiple large freight trucks are present, which have larger blind spots and longer braking distances.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right background

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: There are no signals, stop signs, or active warning devices to manage the interaction between pedestrians and vehicles at this wide crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire intersection area

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to break up the crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver awareness and yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, featuring a wide multi-lane industrial roadway with minimal crossing infrastructure. While a sidewalk and crosswalk exist for a side entrance, the main thoroughfare lacks protected crossings, exposing pedestrians to high-speed traffic over a significant distance.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The main roadway is extremely wide, requiring pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the main thoroughfare

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide lanes and open geometry encourage high vehicle speeds in an industrial context with heavy vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Fencing and industrial equipment near the corner may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the side street crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the warehouse entrance

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time safely.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Implement continental or ladder style markings to make the crossing points more visible to approaching drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, featuring a wide, unmarked industrial intersection with no sidewalks, crosswalks, or pedestrian signals. Pedestrians are forced to share space with heavy vehicles in an area designed exclusively for industrial traffic flow.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: The total absence of sidewalks forces pedestrians to walk in the roadway alongside vehicular traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the edges of the roadway throughout the scene

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians with no designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire intersection area in the foreground

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, unmarked expanse of the intersection creates a long exposure time for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: The center of the intersection

interventions.title: Sidewalk and Curb Ramp Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks and pedestrian signal heads to provide clear guidance and dedicated crossing time.

interventions.title: Intersection Tightening
interventions.description: Use curb extensions or refuge islands to reduce the crossing distance and slow turning vehicle speeds.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and overhead traffic signals but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands. The industrial setting and wide roadway geometry suggest a car-oriented environment with significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white truck is parked close to the intersection, potentially blocking the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk from the right.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the foreground/midground

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks visible pedestrian-specific signal heads, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicle lights.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection signal poles

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing their time in the conflict zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.
